artworks.title: Ralph or Rudolph Corbie, Society of Jesus
artworks.description: The image is a bust portrait of a man. The man is positioned facing slightly to his left, with his head turned towards the viewer. He has distinct facial features, with closely set eyes, a pronounced nose, and a slight smile on his lips. His hair is dark, curly, and composed around his head with a center part. He is wearing a dark garment with a high collar that partially obscures his neck, and a rope or cord is visible on the clothing near his shoulder. The background is plain, with a parchment-like texture and text surrounding the portrait. Words appear in an arc above his head.

artworks.title: Abraham Cowley
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up. The person is facing forward, holding a book. They have wavy, shoulder-length hair, large eyes, and a straight nose. The person wears a garment with a wide collar. Above their head, an illustrated cherub holds a laurel wreath. The background has an oval frame with Latin text encircling the portrait. The image style is reminiscent of historical engravings.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth in an Oval
artworks.description: The image shows Queen Elizabeth I in a portrait display, facing slightly to the left. She has a composed expression with detailed facial features. Her hair is styled elaborately with a small crown or tiara. She wears a regal dress with a large ruff around her neck, featuring intricate patterns and textures. The garment is decorated with embroidery, including a cross-like ornament at her chest. The portrait is framed in an oval shape, with historical text in the background. The document includes decorative typography and stylistic flourishes.

artworks.title: Daniel Featley
artworks.description: The image depicts a man lying down on a raised surface with his arms crossed over his chest and eyes closed. He is in a resting position with a serene expression, supported by a pillow and covered with draping fabric. The man's face is visible, surrounded by illustrations of a palm tree on the left and another tree on the right with clouds and rays in the sky between them. Below him, there is a block of text in English and Latin framed by the edges of the raised surface. The background is detailed with a cross-hatched technique.

artworks.title: Henrietta Maria and Three Princesses
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with dignity in a formal portrait setting. She has curly hair, wears an elaborate gown with high lace collar, and holds a quill in her right hand near a table with documents. Three young girls in similar dresses stand behind her, the tallest holding a doll. The background includes draped curtains and an architectural element resembling a column.

artworks.title: William Laud, Archbishop of Canterbury
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a mustache and short, neat hair facing to his left, holding a book. He is wearing clerical attire from an earlier period with a high collar, possibly including a ruff, under a dark outer garment resembling a robe or cloak with wide sleeves. The background is plain, with the man framed by inscriptions and two emblems or coat of arms. A caption states he is the Archbishop of Canterbury.

artworks.title: Colonel John Lilburne
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing behind a wooden stand or desk. He has shoulder-length wavy hair and a mustache. He is wearing a long coat, elaborate pants, and pointed shoes. The man is holding an open book with the words "Copes Order" visible. There are two large medallions displayed above him. The background has a checkered floor pattern, with words stitched or engraved saying "The names of the Iury of Life and death."

artworks.title: William Macdowell, Scottish Professor at Groningen
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man. He is showing his upper body in a slightly angled position, facing forward with a slight turn to his right. His facial features include deeply set eyes, a prominent nose, and slightly pursed lips. He has long, wavy hair that is parted down the middle and flows past his collar. The man is dressed in a dark, formal garment with a wide white collar that has corners resting over his shoulders. There are no visible pieces of jewelry, and he is not holding any objects. The background features intricate linework typical of engraving, creating a decorative oval frame around the portrait. Text encircles the oval frame, and additional text appears beneath the image.

artworks.title: Sir Walter Raleigh
artworks.description: The illustration shows a man seated in a relaxed, forward-facing position. His facial features are detailed with neatly groomed facial hair, including a short moustache and a tuft under the lower lip. His curly, light-colored hair is closely cropped. The man wears period attire with a rich, patterned fabric and a large lace ruff around his neck. He holds a book upright in one hand. The background has a detailed etched pattern. An inscription at the bottom describes the subject.

artworks.title: Sydrach Simpson
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, facing slightly to the left and looking directly at the viewer. He has a neatly trimmed mustache and goatee, curled medium-length hair partially covered by a black cap, and is dressed in period attire with a large white collar, a dark robe, and visible sleeves with turned-up cuffs. In his right hand, he holds a closed book resting on his chest, with his left hand placed over it. The background includes a dark curtain on the left side and a plain light-colored wall behind him. At the bottom of the image, text identifies the person as Mr. Sydrach Simpson, along with details of his academic and religious roles.

artworks.title: William Slater, D.D., Chaplain of the Queen of Denmark
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a prominent facial features, a long thick beard, styled hair, and a distinctive collar. The background is textured, and there is an inscription at the bottom identifying the man as "Mr. William Slater, D.D."

artworks.title: Joseph Symonds, Vice-Provost of Eton
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man's upper body in a formal stance. He has a beard, mustache, curled hair, and wears a flat cap, dark robe with patterns, and a white collar. The man holds a closed book. The background is an oval frame within a rectangle, emphasizing the figure.

artworks.title: James Ussher, Archbishop of Armagh
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the upper torso up, facing forward with his hands visible. He has an aged face with distinct facial features, a beard, a mustache, and a cap covering his hair. He wears a high-collared ruff, a detailed robe, and there is an emblem or coat of arms on the left side. The background features parallel lines for texture, and beneath the portrait is a script identifying him as "The right reverend Father in god James Usher Arch-bishop of Armagh and primate of all Ireland."

artworks.title: William Whateley, Puritan Vicar of Banbury
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved portrait of a man with his upper body visible, facing forward but looking slightly to the side. The man has a defined nose, prominent cheekbones, a full beard extending into a mustache, and wears a cap with decorative patterns. He is dressed in historical formal attire with a ruffled collar. The oval frame surrounding the portrait includes text identifying him as "Guilelmi Whatelei Theologi Effigies Illustrissimi Viri et Vere Venerabilis," with additional Latin text below.

artworks.title: Man With a Dog
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a relaxed pose, leaning against a tree. The person has distinct facial features, medium-length wavy hair under a wide-brimmed hat, and is wearing a 17th-century outfit. They hold a cane and a dog stands beside them. The background includes a tree trunk and detailed ground work.

artworks.title: Iconologia or Morall Emblems by Caesar Ripa
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical scene with intricate human figures and detailed architecture. Figures are depicted in dynamic poses, some draped in fabric, others in motion or conversation. The background features large architectural elements like columns and a relief sculpture. A decorated vessel or sailing ship is seen. Elaborate ornamental designs frame the lower part. The text "Iconologia or Morall Emblems by Caesar Ripa of Perugia" is included, suggesting a connection to moral emblems. The detailed engraving style resembles classical European artwork, possibly from the Renaissance or Baroque period.

artworks.title: Thomas Howard, Earl of Arundel
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the torso upward. He is facing slightly to the left with his head turned back towards the viewer. The man has robust facial features, a mustache, and a beard. His curly hair flows just past his ears. He is wearing a detailed armored breastplate over a high-collared garment, and has a medallion necklace. The background is plain, framed by an oval border within a rectangular canvas. The bottom includes text stating the man's name and title: "Thomas, Earle of Arundell. Earle Marshall of England," along with publication information.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon in a Niche
artworks.description: An engraving of a full-body representation of a seated man inside a large architectural niche. The man is sitting with his body slightly turned to the right, resting his right elbow on the armrest and his left hand raised to his chin. He has detailed facial features, wears a broad-brimmed hat, and elaborate clothing typical of the late Renaissance period. The background shows a stone archway with classical details, and text inscribed beneath the niche in Latin.

artworks.title: Charles II as Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person shown from the chest up at a slight angle, looking to the side. The person has a youthful face with smooth skin and curly hair falling just above their shoulders. They are wearing ornate clothing with a patterned lace collar and a detailed garment, and a sash across the chest. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, with an oval border framing the portrait. The text below reads: "Charles by the grace of God Prince of Wales, Duke of Cornwall, York and Albany borne May 29 1630."

artworks.title: Charles II as Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a young male figure from the mid-chest upwards. He is slightly turned to his right, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. The young man has curly hair falling to his shoulders and soft facial features with a gentle expression. He wears an elaborate garment with a large lace collar, decorated with patterns, and a sash across his chest. No visible jewelry is present, and his hands are not shown. The background is plain with a slightly arched border framing the subject. Below the portrait is text identifying the individual as Charles, with titles detailing his royal status and birth date.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Cromwell
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.description: The image displays the upper body of a seated man turned slightly left. His hands are resting on a surface in front of him. The man has a straight nose and a strong jawline, with short, wavy, light-colored hair under a cap. He wears dark, heavy clothing, possibly a cloak or robe edged with fur. On the table are various objects, including an ornate box, scrolls, and papers. The man is holding an object in his left hand, and wearing a ring on one finger. The background is a wooden panel, with an inscription under the table mentioning Sir Thomas Cromwell Knight.

artworks.title: Robert Devereux, Third Earl of Essex
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man on horseback. The man is confidently seated on a rearing horse, with his body angled slightly to the right. He has distinct facial features, shoulder-length wavy hair, and wears armor with elaborate detailing. He is draped in a billowing cape and holds a baton in his right hand. The background features a sky with numerous clouds. Below the image is an inscription detailing the identity and accomplishments of the person depicted.

artworks.title: Henry Hastings, Fifth Earl of Huntingdon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest upwards. He has a styled beard and mustache, round eyes, high cheekbones, and curly hair visible under a cap. He wears a dark outfit with a high-collared shirt and ruff. The background is plain with a double oval line framing the man.

artworks.title: Philip Herbert, Fourth Earl of Pembroke
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man with long, wavy hair, a pronounced mustache, and detailed facial features. He is wearing a richly adorned outfit with an elaborate lace collar and puffy sleeves. A piece of jewelry is displayed around his neck. The background features intricate geometric patterns within a circular border. Below the image, there is a text panel with titles and information about the man.
